evidence: Plotted in Figure 3 are root-mean-square (rms) roughness data collected on the AlOx layers with various Rc using AFM, revealing the presence of a window of Rc ∼ 0.2 within which the rms roughness was minimized. Beyond the Rc ∼ 0.2 window, the rms roughness appeared to increase as Rc increased. Shown as insets in Figure 3 are representative AFM images (500 nm × 500 nm scan) collected from the AlOx samples with Rc ) 0.002 (11 nm rms roughness) on the top and Rc ) 0.301 (2.4 nm rms roughness) on the bottom, showing characteristic granular features on two different surfaces.
